title: feat(app-shell): page designer for html/react pages: a numbered source editor with a save status, a Properties tab with the page's metadata, and a disabled Run switch that says why (objectui#12522)
body:
Fixes #12522
Clause-②: no

## What changed

**Source tab (target 1).** Measured on main: when Monaco loads, the editor already meets the target (12 px mono, line numbers, full panel height, wrapping). The test pass caught the loading skeleton and then the plain-textarea fallback that the editor drops to when Monaco cannot load (offline, air-gapped, strict CSP). That fallback lacked line numbers. It now draws a line-number gutter, wraps long lines and fills the panel. Each source line is mirrored in an invisible row with the same font, width and wrapping, so a number sits on the first visual row of its line. A one-line status under the editor reads Unsaved while an edit is pending, Saved HH:MM once the pillar's own save lands (the time is formatted in the display locale), and Saved for a draft read but not edited in this visit. No new save path: the time is recorded where the existing leaf save succeeds, tied to the leaf it saved.

**Properties tab (target 2).** The new SourcePageProperties panel shows:
- the label, editable in the designer locale through the existing renamedLabel, so a per-language label keeps its other languages;
- the identifier, read-only (it is the name every save addresses);
- 'Written in' (HTML or React), read-only, as the create dialog words it, because the Studio does not change a page's kind;
- every navigation entry that opens the page, at any depth, with the groups it sits in, read from the navigation tree the pillar already holds.

It writes only `label`.

**Run (target 3).** On an html or react page Design and Run draw the same live preview, so the switch is disabled. The reason uses the objectui#12303 pattern: a focusable wrapper that is the tooltip trigger, with a visually hidden copy that the wrapper and both buttons point aria-describedby at. Block-tree pages keep a working switch: Design draws the block canvas (region label, block cards, Add block, Add region) and Run renders the page as the app does. A new test pins that control.

The data-testids if-inspector, if-canvas-caption and canvas-mode-toggle are kept.

## Deviations
- Two i18n keys, engine.studio.inspector.sourcePageLine1 and sourcePageLine2 (en and zh), are retired: they held the old Properties-tab copy this card replaces. The dead-keys and drift gates are green.
- Besides the page branch, three small spots in InterfacesPillar changed: the header's Design/Run switch, one state hook, and one line in the existing leaf save that records the saved-at time. The canvas mount and studio-canvas-preview.tsx are untouched.
- Not changed: in the folded (chat dock) layout the Properties tab is still the source editor alone, now with the status line.
